tpms.when: 2015–2016 Versa sedan (no reset button; clears after driving)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive above 16 mph (25 km/h). The light does not go out right after you add air; it goes out once the system re-reads the tires while driving.
If the light stays on after a few miles, recheck all four pressures with a gauge.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault or a wheel without a sensor (such as the spare) is fitted. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2015 and 2016 Versa Sedan owner's manuals.
